---
name: Flag request
about: Request support for a new Apple Health flag (data type)
title: "[flag]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Flag identifier**
The `type` value as it appears in your export, e.g. `HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount`.

**Name and unit**
Display name (e.g. Step Count) and unit (e.g. count, kcal, bpm).

**Sample record**
One anonymised `<Record .../>` line from `export.xml` (remove personal data).

**Suggested color / colormap (optional)**
A hex color and a matplotlib colormap, e.g. `#FF5733` and `viridis`.

**Additional context**
Anything else, such as whether it is a quantity, category or sleep-like type.
